note: Synthetic test data. Northwind Robotics is a fictional company. Every planted defect is listed; all other formulas are intended to be correct.

bugs.description: FY26E other assets is typed as 1,012.5; the roll-forward needs 1,000.0. The FY26E check at BS!D15 reads 12.5.
FY27E SG&A is a typed number in a calculation row. The formula gives 344.4.
Memo cell refers to a deleted cell on the Inputs sheet. Nothing depends on it.
FY27E COGS multiplies by the gross margin instead of one minus the gross margin. The rest of row 6 uses the D6 pattern.
FY27E change in receivables has the wrong sign. An increase in receivables should reduce cash. Cash is overstated by 20.0, so the FY27E check at BS!E15 reads 20.0.
